body:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Paging: silvergrove-prod - vpc tenant 'silvergrove' toolcall parser errors spiked to 7.8% in last 5m (>= 5% threshold). Auto-escalation to eng-oncall.

Alice M: seeing the same in the dashboards. Errors are mostly \"jsonstream fragmentation\" coming from multipart toolcall payloads.

Ben O: confirming customer is on Dedicated pool 'dg-3'. Impact looks limited to the customer but we should treat as P1 since affected endpoints are core billing flows.

Chandra (Customer SRE): customer reports intermittent 500s from our toolcall proxy, their side shows truncated arrays in responses. They're stuck on a tight window for reconciliation.

Maria (oncall): quick status: are we able to repro locally with their payloads?

Sam (runtime): trying a quick repro now with sample from support ticket. Repro succeeds when request has mixed-line delimiters and a late-EOF fragment; our streaming parser currently bails instead of rebuffering.

Sam (runtime): code snippet of failing path:
```
# simplified pseudocode
while (stream.hasNext()) {
  chunk = stream.next();
  if (!isValidPartial(chunk)) {
    throw ParserError(\"fragmentation\");
  }
  buffer.append(chunk);
}
```

Alice M: looks like recent parser refactor (r4592) changed permissiveness. Might be a regression to strictness.

Ben O: can we enable a compatibility shim per-tenant? We should avoid global changes.

Sam (runtime): yes. I can flip `parser.compat_mode` to `lenient` for tenant silvergrove in the routing config. That will allow reassembly of fragmented jsonstreams. Will need a config push to edge and a small restart of the proxy process.

Maria (oncall): customer impact? Chandra?

Chandra (Customer SRE): if you flip to lenient they can get uninterrupted traffic. They want ETA. This is high priority for them.

Alice M: plan proposal: 1) enable per-tenant shim, 2) monitor error rate, 3) push a hotfix with unit tests and a canary to dedicated pool, 4) coordinate rollback if we see new regressions.

Sam (runtime): stepping through commands. Will apply config via the ops route: 
```bash
# apply per-tenant override
redwoodctl config set --tenant silvergrove parser.compat_mode=lenient --env prod --commit \"shim for fragmentation\"
redwoodctl deploy --component toolcall-proxy --tenants silvergrove --restart
```

DeployBot: deploy started for toolcall-proxy -> silvergrove (job id deploy-8271)

Maria (oncall): I'll watch errors and tail logs. Running quick log query:
```bash
rg \"ParserError|fragmentation\" /var/log/proxy/*.log | tail -n 50
```

Maria (oncall): immediate drop from 7.8% -> 1.1% after config flip :thumbsup: Noticed a small increase in latency (~40ms p50).

Sam (runtime): acceptable tradeoff. Will add metrics filter to monitor p95 latency and error class increase.

Alice M: customer-facing comms: Chandra, can you confirm if their reconciliation window is unblocked? If yes, we'll keep shim for 2 hours while hotfix builds.

Chandra (Customer SRE): confirmed with customer: they see successful job runs again. Will keep loop open for 30m to validate historical backlog catch-up.

Ben O: good. Next: hotfix. I will branch and include a targeted fix to rebuffer partial frames instead of throwing. Tests + integration. Estimated patch + CI 90m. Sam can we canary on 1 node in the dedicated pool?

Sam (runtime): yes. Canary plan:
- apply hotfix image tag hotfix/frag-2512
- canary to 1 proxy shard in dg-3 (silvergrove's pool)
- monitor errors + latency for 15m

Ben O: execute when ready. Post-canary we can roll to rest of the pool.

DeployBot: deploy job deploy-8271 completed: config applied and proxy restarted for tenants: silvergrove

Maria (oncall): Monitoring: error rate holding < 1.5% across 20m, no new error classes. p95 latency +35ms. CPU bump on shard +6%.

Alice M: decision: keep lenient shim active and proceed with hotfix canary. If hotfix looks safe, remove shim and roll patch.

Sam (runtime): pushing hotfix image to staging for canary build now. CI artifacts at `ci.redwood/silvergrove/hotfix/2512`

Chandra (Customer SRE): heads-up to customer that we'll be doing a canary patch later, may cause brief hiccups. They're OK and appreciate the quick mitigation.

Ben O: also preparing a postmortem template. Key items: regression introduced by parser refactor r4592, missing fuzz tests for jsonstream fragmentation cases, need per-tenant feature flags for parsing strictness.

Alice M: handoff: Maria please stay on until hotfix canary completes and then hand back to Sam for patch rollout. Tag me if anything spikes.

Maria (oncall): will do. Currently pinned on pager until 12:30 UTC.

Sam (runtime): canary started (canary id c-930). Observing metrics... so far green for 8m.

Maria (oncall): confirm p95 + no error class. Green at 15m.

DeployBot: canary deploy c-930 succeeded. Scaling patch to remaining shards in dg-3.

Chandra (Customer SRE): customer confirmed all reconciliation jobs completed successfully. Thanks team.

Alice M: closing note: we'll keep an action to add fragmentation tests to the parser suite and an alert to detect sudden drops in jsonstream assembly success. I'll add to backlog and tag runtime team.

Ben O: adding runbook step to prefer per-tenant shim over global rollback when fragmentation observed.

Incident Bot: incident resolved - silvergrove parser fragmentation spike mitigated.

Maria (oncall): handing off to Sam for post-deploy verification and PMRM.

Sam (runtime): taking postmortem and will file retrospective ticket with timeline, diff links, and CC list.

Alice M: thanks everyone. :handshake:
